messages:
maria: Heads-up: doing EU canary deploy for release v2026.3.1 in 10m. Plan: cohort_splitback FF -> 10% (canary) wait 15m -> 50% wait 30m -> 100%.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] release v2026.3.1 -> eu cluster. kickoff in 10 minutes. link: https://redwood-internal/releases/2026.3.1

aj: Q: are we pinning routing to v3-build14 for the canary or allowing mixed routing? I'd prefer pin to v3-build14 to minimize variables.

maria: pinning to v3-build14 for canary. will unpin after 50% if healthy.

ops-jen: Adding rollback criteria here so it's explicit: rollback if error-rate >0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency >300ms for 5m. Abort if model mismatch errors >0.1%. I'll also run the quiet-window monitors.

ryan: +1. Also suggest flag schedule TTL so cohorts don't survive long after we forget. planned values: 0.1 -> 0.5 -> 1.0.

sre-kate: Monitoring hooks prepped: dashboards /dash/deploys/v2026.3.1, trace alert rule `deploy_id=3498765432`, and a log filter for model-rejection.

aj: ramp commands I'll run: ```/ff set cohort_splitback 0.1 --annot "canary start"``` then after checks ```/ff set cohort_splitback 0.5 --annot "50% ramp"```

maria: quiet window: 15m between steps, tagging @ops-jen to watch metrics and call rollback if anything odd.

ops-jen: watching. will post metric snapshots every 5m. if abnormal I'll flip to 0 immediately and open an incident.

deploy-bot: [deploy started] canary -> 10% (actor: deploy-bot) timestamp=3498765432

deploy-bot: [health update] canary at 10% healthy (error-rate 0.02%, p95 220ms)

maria: moving to 50% in ~3m if metrics steady.

aj: executing: `/ff set cohort_splitback 0.5` now.

deploy-bot: [flag change] cohort_splitback -> 0.5 (actor: aj)

sre-kate: metrics snapshot: error-rate 0.03% p95 260ms, no regression in QPS. continuing to monitor.

ryan: added a short release note snippet: https://redwood-internal/notes/2026.3.1 (will expand post-rollout)

maria: plan: 50% soak for 30m, then unpin routing and finish roll to 100% if clean.

ops-jen: spelled out rollback action: run `/run rollback v2026.3.1` and set `cohort_splitback=0.0` if criteria breach. Ops will coordinate comms.

aj: quick unpin command if we go forward: `routing pin remove v3-build14 --deploy 3498765432`

deploy-bot: [update] 50% soak started. next scheduled check in 15m.

sre-kate: FYI small spike in token rejection count (~0.08%), digging now (cc @maria).

maria: thanks. if that's model rejection we'll drop to 10% and revert the recent quantization tweak for the canary.

ops-jen: noted. standing by to reduce cohort or open rollback.

deploy-bot: [health update] 50% soak at 15m mark: error-rate 0.04%, p95 275ms, no sustained spikes.

maria: proceeding to full roll after 30m soak if steady.

aj: executing final ramp: `/ff set cohort_splitback 1.0` in 2m.

deploy-bot: [flag change] cohort_splitback -> 1.0 (actor: aj)

deploy-bot: [complete] v2026.3.1 rolled to 100% in EU. release notes: https://redwood-internal/notes/2026.3.1 :tada:

maria: great work team. follow-ups: add TTL telemetry to Optimize, add canary prompt set to release docs, and file a small PR to capture rollback knobs in the runbook.

ops-jen: will close the watch unless rollback occurs. :thumbsup:

sre-kate: adding post-deploy checklist entry to release doc now.
